author: Zurigen

title: Had to quit before getting crazy
body:
Not sure what is the science behind this app, but I do not know why one should spend 12 $/month for something that is freely available  on YouTube. Tracks are extremely repetitive, and they actually got me distracted and nervous rather then concentrated and relaxed.
There seems to be no binaural effect to the tracks either, which is the basis to stimulate the brain as far as I know.
The only relief I got is taking the headphone off.
author: Giorgiomotivationalguy

title: Great for sleep and focus
body: I love this app since many years, it's great for sleeping, napping or focusing. It works very well. One thing I can never get to work, however, is offline mode. Whenever I'm in a plane and try to play tracks from the offline library, it doesn't work and complains that I should check my internet connection. I don't understand what the purpose of the offline / download feature is if it only works with an internet connection. I still give this app 5 stars though because it helps me so much with sleeping and focusing. But it would be great if this could be fixed so I can use it to nap or sleep when flying.

author: anotjer nickname

title: Great app, a couple of persistent glitches
body:
I have been using the app for over half a year and found it very helpful!
I have 2 glitches to report:
1. When trying to switch to another track once in a session, it keeps returning the same track at least 3 times before finally moving on to something else. I reported this bug earlier but it still persists in the new version
2. Whenever trying to extend the session after it finishes, the new session wouldn’t load (shows a permanent “loading” symbol). One needs to restart the app to be able to play again. 
In the new version, I just get a “connection error” whenever trying to start another session after previous one ended. I suspect the underlying problem is the same.
I am an IPhone 6s user.
